variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash. openFPGALoader loads its SPI-over-JTAG bridge for the FPGA part (xc7a50tfgg484, in oss-cad-suite's share/openFPGALoader), then writes the board's SPI flash. Not tried on hardware. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware. USB filter (2026-11-05): the product name from Numato's own OpenOCD file (numato/samplecode FPGA/MimasA7/openocd/numato_mimasa7.cfg) and OpenOCD's tcl/board/numato_mimas_a7.cfg; 2a19 is Numato's vendor ID.
